title: Watcher's file
description: GM-ONLY. What the Watcher has actually observed about one player character, and nothing else. The Watcher is the campaign's adversary and Claude plays it (ideas/story/dossier-observer.md); this file is the hard gate that keeps it fair: it may only exploit what is recorded here as known. Every observation comes from the fiction (a rolled check, a fight it watched, an in-character message or document it could read). Nothing real about a player may ever be recorded. Lives in data/watcher/, which is deliberately NOT synced to the Foundry server. Pure logic: module/blank-inheritance/scripts/core/watcher-file.mjs.

subjectRef.description: The id of the player character this file is about (a kid, or a Frame's pilot).

source.description: Where the Watcher saw it. Every source is inside the fiction. recall-knowledge is a check one of its children rolled openly against the character; the others are things it watched or read on the substrate it is native to.

category.description: What kind of thing it learned.

key.description: What exactly, e.g. 'athletics', 'will', 'covers-the-left-flank-first', a named NPC the character cares about.

value.description: What it learned about the key, if anything more than that it exists: a modifier, a description, a name.

degree.description: For recall-knowledge only. A plain failure teaches nothing and is never recorded. A critical failure is recorded as a mistaken belief.

mistaken.description: True when the Watcher believes something false (a critically failed check). It will act on it, and the party can exploit that.

observedIn.description: Where it happened: an episode, scene or encounter id.
